name: clip1
text: A small brown bird flying fast through a bright early-summer green forest, leaves rustling and branches swaying, sunlight flickering through the canopy, the camera following the bird quickly. Cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no logos.

name: clip2
text: Fast time-lapse of fresh green leaves blowing in strong wind on a mountain slope, bright clouds racing across a blue sky, long grass rippling in waves, the camera tracking sideways. Realistic look, no people, no text, no logos.

name: clip3
text: Sudden rain falling hard through a bamboo grove, bamboo stalks bending in the wind, water splashing on wet stones, mist drifting quickly between the stalks, the camera pushing forward. Cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no logos.

name: clip4
text: Wind-blown ink-like clouds rolling over dark mountain ridges at dusk, a flock of small birds crossing the glowing orange sky, tree branches swaying in the foreground, the camera drifting forward. Cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no logos.

name: clip5
text: A sea of clouds flowing quickly between mountain peaks at sunrise, golden light spreading, a bird gliding across the frame and circling, tree tops swaying, the camera rising upward. Cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no logos.
